name: β-alaninium amide to D-pantetheine 4'-phosphate
summary: A 7-step route from β-alaninium amide to D-pantetheine 4'-phosphate(2−), ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: phosphopantothenate--cysteine ligase (CTP)
reactions.equation: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP = N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H(+)

reactions.name: tRNA 2-selenouridine synthase
reactions.equation: 5-methylaminomethyl-2-thiouridine(34) in tRNA + selenophosphate + (2E)-geranyl diphosphate + H2O + H(+) = 5-methylaminomethyl-2-selenouridine(34) in tRNA + (2E)-thiogeraniol + phosphate + diphosphate

reactions.name: N-carbamoyl-L-cysteine + H2O + 2 H(+) = L-cysteine + NH4(+) + CO2
reactions.equation: N-carbamoyl-L-cysteine + H2O + 2 H(+) = L-cysteine + NH4(+) + CO2

reactions.name: a tRNA precursor + 2 CTP = a tRNA with a 3' CC end + 2 diphosphate
reactions.equation: a tRNA precursor + 2 CTP = a tRNA with a 3' CC end + 2 diphosphate

reactions.name: N-acetylglucosaminide alpha-(2,6)-sialyltransferase
reactions.equation: an N-acetyl-alpha-neuraminyl-(2->3)-beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-N-acetyl-beta-D-galactosaminyl derivative + CMP-N-acetyl-beta-neuraminate = an alpha-Neu5Ac-(2->3)-beta-D-Gal-(1->3)-[alpha-Neu5Ac-(2->6)]-beta-D-GalNAc derivative + CMP + H(+)
